summary: Diff implements major parts of the requested ADMINISTRATOR role and expanded admin dashboard: new #admin role type on backend, default admin password string, new AdminPasswordGate UI, presence heartbeat hook, and expanded admin metrics cards. However, key backend enforcement details (leader allowlist checks by profile name/phone normalization, trapping on unauthorized admin saves, and restricting admin password changes to allowlisted leader admins) are not verifiable from the provided truncated backend diff summary. Several unrelated UI/feature changes (pairing UX, live location UI, polling tweaks, transparency page edits) appear outside the BuildRequest scope.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must enforce that only leader-allowlisted accounts can save a profile with role #admin (trap/reject for non-allowlisted), and allowlist matching must support profile.name equals either allowlisted email and profile.phoneNumber equals “(91)980115950” after normalization.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the new role variant (#admin) and new allowlistedAdminPrincipals state, but does not include (in the visible/truncated portion) the saveCallerUserProfile implementation or the explicit allowlist matching logic against profile.name / profile.phoneNumber with the specified normalization and trap behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Restrict admin-password changes so that only leader-allowlisted admins can change the admin password; other callers must be rejected; verifyAdminPassword must only return true for the correct password.
missing_requirements.reason: The default password value is visible, and the frontend includes a change-password UI gated by an allowlist query, but the backend methods (verifyAdminPassword / setAdminPassword) and their authorization checks are not shown in the truncated backend diff, so backend enforcement cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose an admin-only metrics query returning all requested counts including active sessions estimate computed from heartbeat timestamps within a recent window.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.getAdminDashboardMetrics() and sends actor.recordHeartbeat(), but the backend implementations for these methods, the admin-only restriction, and the windowed computation for “active sessions” are not visible in the truncated backend diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: All additional admin dashboard metrics must be available via an admin-only backend query and rendered on the admin dashboard, without exposing individual child activity/location records (aggregated only).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend renders multiple additional metrics (e.g., pending pairings, disabled accounts, schedules/filters configured), but the backend-side admin-only query shape and any guarantees about aggregation-only (no individual record exposure) are not visible in the truncated backend diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Multiple unrelated UX/feature changes to child pairing flow (phone-based pairing steps, pending state polling, URL pairingCode handling) beyond adding ADMINISTRATOR role and admin metrics.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on restricted ADMINISTRATOR role, admin password gate, presence heartbeat, and admin metrics; it does not request changes to child-parent pairing UX or related polling behaviors.

hallucinated_features.description: Live location UI enhancements (badges, stale detection, Google Maps link, polling cadence changes) beyond admin-role/dashboard work.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; scope is admin access control and dashboard metrics.

hallucinated_features.description: General polling/refresh tweaks for parent/child activity and history components (15-second polling, etc.) outside the admin/dashboard requirements.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of requested ADMINISTRATOR role additions or admin metrics expansion.

hallucinated_features.description: Edits to TransparencyPolicies content/translation and minor Tailwind class changes unrelated to admin role/metrics.
